payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate x from max(0, n-100) to n-1, compute digit sum, collect x if x+digit_sum equals n.
payload.rationale: The solution prunes the search space using a simple bound (max digit sum ≈ 81, widened to 100), which is a form of branch and bound. Other complete_search subtypes (backtracking, bitmask, DFS/BFS, permutations) do not apply.
